description: This file contains unit tests for the TimezonesAPI class within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It tests API endpoint behavior related to timezone management in the application, including retrieving all timezones and handling unimplemented methods like delete and create.

classes.name: TimezonesAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to perform integration tests on the TimezonesAPI endpoint within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically testing retrieval of timezone data and ensuring certain methods properly throw not implemented exceptions.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the testGetAll method, adjusting the dataset based on PHP version for compatibility.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling delete() on the TimezonesAPI throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that getValidationRuleForDelete() raises a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that create() method on the API raises a 'not implemented' exception.
